## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mosaicData)
data("Marriage")
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
p <- ggplot(Marriage, aes (x = delay)) + geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "grey80") + labs(title = "Most of the marriages don't have delays between liscences and ceremonies", subtitle = "Delay length of marriage ceremony") + theme_minimal()


p
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
p2 <- ggplot(Marriage, aes(delay))+ geom_density(bw =2) + theme_minimal()
p2

p3 <- ggplot(Marriage, aes (x = delay))+ geom_histogram(aes (y = after_stat(density)),bins = 20, fill = "red") + labs(title = "Most of the marriages don't have delays between liscences and ceremonies", subtitle = "Delay length of marriage ceremony")  + geom_density(bw = 2, linewidth = 1) + theme_minimal()
p3
```
